scope: Public-constant FP32 compatibility check of the specific STENSO x/sqrt(x) -> sqrt(x) example. Not a Vortex model benchmark.
hypothesis: The unguarded displayed transformation is bitwise equivalent for all positive finite binary32 x.
environment_policy: Save and restore caller fenv. No persistent system setting changes.
independent_expectation: Python Fraction exact nearest-neighbor proof for sqrt(3) and 3/RN32(sqrt(3)). No numerical library oracle in that proof.
failure_scope: Only the displayed unguarded rewrite's exact-value suitability, not all STENSO outputs or all possible Vortex algorithms.
